source_policy: Primary publisher-hosted engineering sources support candidate formulation only; they are not Owner-vetted project authority. No domains/piping-design OCR equations were used.

external.title: Pressure Vessels
external.author: David Roylance
external.checked_sections: pp. 2-3 closed-end axial and hoop equilibrium; pp. 5-7 plane-stress Poisson strain and separately restrained end plates
external.applicability: Thin-wall equilibrium, tension-positive signs, and Poisson coupling. Does not establish project approximation limits, thick-wall behavior, or acceptance tolerances.

external.title: Structural Mechanics in Nuclear Power Technology, Note L.4
external.checked_sections: pp. 22-24 exact annulus area, closed-end average axial stress, thin-wall reduction and strain; pp. 27-30 thick-cylinder generalized plane-strain/Lame solution
external.applicability: Axisymmetric homogeneous isotropic linear-elastic cylinder away from end discontinuities. Supplies the thick-wall oracle and restrained axial relation; it does not cover bend ovalization, expansion joints, nonlinear material response, or project thresholds.

external.title: Distributed Loads — Pressure on Pipe and Elbow Elements
external.checked_sections: Pressure on Pipe and Elbow Elements
external.applicability: Independent confirmation that a pipe-element load convention must identify closed ends, internal cancellation, and explicit open-end compensation. Product documentation is comparative terminology, not a numerical oracle or Chirality authority.

external.title: Beam Element Library — Section Forces
external.applicability: Independent confirmation of a separately named effective axial force, ESF1=SF1+peAe-piAi. It does not require Chirality to adopt another product's naming, sign convention, or implementation.
